QUANTUM VULNERABLE   Shor's algorithm breaks these outright

  RSA  (no call sites, 3 imports)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-65 for signatures
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:4   import java.security.interfaces.RSAPublicKey;
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:11   import static java.security.spec.RSAKeyGenParameterSpec.F4;
      src/test/java/app/KeysTest.java:3   import java.security.interfaces.RSAPrivateKey;

  DH  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm solves the finite-field discrete log.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203)
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:8   import javax.crypto.interfaces.DHPublicKey;

  ECDSA  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm solves the discrete log on the curve.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), or SLH-DSA if you need hash-based
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:9   import org.bouncycastle.crypto.signers.ECDSASigner;

  EC  (no call sites, 2 imports)
    Shor's algorithm solves the discrete log on the curve. Whether this key signs or agrees keys was not visible to the scanner, and the migration target depends on which.
    migrate to: determine usage before migrating, ML-DSA-65 if signing, ML-KEM-768 if key agreement

ALREADY BROKEN       weak today, quantum is not the issue

  3DES  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Sweet32 birthday attacks. Disallowed by NIST for encryption after 2023.
    migrate to: AES-256-GCM
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:7   import javax.crypto.spec.DESedeKeySpec;

  SHA-1  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Chosen-prefix collisions demonstrated in 2020. Retire it.
    migrate to: SHA-256 or SHA-3
      src/main/java/app/Keys.java:10   import org.bouncycastle.crypto.digests.SHA1Digest;
